examples.en: Missing the first train was a blessing in disguise.
examples.zh: 錯過第一班火車原來是因禍得福。

examples.en: The extra practice has been a blessing in disguise.
examples.zh: 額外的練習原來帶來了意想不到的好處。

meaning.en: A blessing in disguise is something that seems bad, unlucky or disappointing at first but later produces a good result or unexpected advantage.
meaning.zh: 「a blessing in disguise」 表示某件事起初看似不幸、倒霉或令人失望，但後來卻帶來好結果或意想不到的好處。
naturalZh: 「a blessing in disguise」 表示某件事起初看似不幸、倒霉或令人失望，但後來卻帶來好結果或意想不到的好處。

register.summaryEn: everyday conversation; personal stories; interviews; workplace discussions; presentations; newspaper and magazine writing; general essays.
register.summaryZh: 這個表達屬中性至略帶口語色彩，可自然用於日常對話、個人故事、訪問、工作討論、簡報、報章雜誌及一般文章。
register.formalEn: Use the idiom only in the contexts described in the source.
register.formalZh: 在關係子句或同位語中使用目標表達

fixedVariable.fixedEn: Keep the fixed words and word order shown in the source expression.
fixedVariable.fixedZh: 保留原檔目標表達中的固定字詞及字序。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Change only the verb form, possessive, tense or surrounding grammar permitted by the source patterns.
fixedVariable.variableZh: 只按照原檔句式改變動詞形式、所有格、時態或前後文法。

forms.form: Subject + is / was / has been / had been / will be + a blessing in disguise.
forms.example: Missing the first train was a blessing in disguise.

forms.form: turn out to be + a blessing in disguise
forms.example: Taking the wrong road turned out to be a blessing in disguise.

forms.form: end up being + a blessing in disguise
forms.example: The booking mistake ended up being a blessing in disguise.

forms.form: prove to be + a blessing in disguise
forms.example: The rejection proved to be a blessing in disguise.

forms.form: Subject + may / might / could + be + a blessing in disguise.
forms.example: The cancelled meeting may be a blessing in disguise.

forms.form: Subject + see / regard / describe + event + as + a blessing in disguise.
forms.example: She later saw the rejection as a blessing in disguise.

forms.form: Subject + consider / call + event + a blessing in disguise.
forms.example: The students considered the failed experiment a blessing in disguise.

forms.form: What seemed like X + be + a blessing in disguise
forms.example: What seemed like a disaster was a blessing in disguise.

forms.form: It + was / may be + a blessing in disguise + that + clause.
forms.example: It was a blessing in disguise that the problem appeared before the busy season.
The delay, which proved to be a blessing in disguise, gave us more time.

forms.form: Looking back, + clause containing the target.
forms.example: Looking back, the change was a blessing in disguise.

specificForms.titleEn: Subject + Be + a Blessing in Disguise
specificForms.formula: Subject + is / was / has been / had been / will be + a blessing in disguise.
specificForms.descriptionEn: This is the simplest and most common grammar frame.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 主語 + be + a blessing in disguise 這是最簡單、最常見的句式。

examples.en: Missing the first train was a blessing in disguise.
examples.zh: 錯過第一班火車原來是因禍得福。

examples.en: The extra practice has been a blessing in disguise.
examples.zh: 額外的練習原來帶來了意想不到的好處。

examples.en: The change may be a blessing in disguise.
examples.zh: 這項改變可能反而是好事。

specificForms.titleEn: Turn Out to Be + a Blessing in Disguise
specificForms.titleZh: 走錯路結果反而是因禍得福
specificForms.formula: turn out to be + a blessing in disguise
specificForms.descriptionEn: Turn out to be emphasises that the true positive result became clear later.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 走錯路結果反而是因禍得福。 強調事情真正的正面結果到了後來才變得清楚。

examples.en: Taking the wrong road turned out to be a blessing in disguise.
examples.zh: 走錯路結果反而是因禍得福。

examples.en: The smaller classroom may turn out to be a blessing in disguise.
examples.zh: 較小的課室最終可能反而帶來好處。

specificForms.titleEn: End Up Being + a Blessing in Disguise
specificForms.titleZh: 訂房錯誤最後反而帶來了好處
specificForms.formula: end up being + a blessing in disguise
specificForms.descriptionEn: ended up being ✓ ended up to be ✗
specificForms.descriptionZh: 訂房錯誤最後反而帶來了好處。 在 end up 後面應使用 being，而不是 to be。

examples.en: The booking mistake ended up being a blessing in disguise.
examples.zh: 訂房錯誤最後反而帶來了好處。

specificForms.titleEn: Prove to Be + a Blessing in Disguise
specificForms.titleZh: 這次拒絕結果反而是因禍得福
specificForms.formula: prove to be + a blessing in disguise
specificForms.descriptionEn: Prove to be suggests that later evidence shows the event’s real value.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 這次拒絕結果反而是因禍得福。 prove to be 表示後來的證據顯示出這件事的真正好處。

examples.en: The rejection proved to be a blessing in disguise.
examples.zh: 這次拒絕結果反而是因禍得福。

examples.en: The delay could prove to be a blessing in disguise.
examples.zh: 這次延誤可能最終反而帶來好處。

specificForms.titleEn: Modal + Be or Prove to Be
specificForms.titleZh: 情態動詞 + be 或 prove to be
specificForms.formula: Subject + may / might / could + be + a blessing in disguise.
specificForms.descriptionEn: Use this structure when the positive result is possible but not yet certain.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 當正面結果仍然只是一種可能，而尚未確定時，應使用這個句式。

examples.en: The cancelled meeting may be a blessing in disguise.
examples.zh: 會議取消可能反而是好事。

examples.en: The refusal could prove to be a blessing in disguise.
examples.zh: 這次拒絕最終可能反而帶來好處。

specificForms.titleEn: See or Regard Something as a Blessing in Disguise
specificForms.titleZh: 把某事視為 a blessing in disguise
specificForms.formula: Subject + see / regard / describe + event + as + a blessing in disguise.
specificForms.descriptionEn: The word as is required after see, regard and describe in these patterns.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 在這些句式中，see、regard 及 describe 後面需要使用 as。

examples.en: She later saw the rejection as a blessing in disguise.
examples.zh: 她後來把這次拒絕視為因禍得福。

examples.en: The owner regarded the quiet week as a blessing in disguise.
examples.zh: 店主把清靜的一星期視為因禍得福。

examples.en: The coach described the defeat as a blessing in disguise.
examples.zh: 教練把這次落敗形容為因禍得福。

specificForms.titleEn: Consider or Call Something a Blessing in Disguise
specificForms.titleZh: 認為或稱某事為 a blessing in disguise
specificForms.formula: Subject + consider / call + event + a blessing in disguise.
specificForms.descriptionEn: considered it a blessing in disguise ✓ considered it as a blessing in disguise ✗
specificForms.descriptionZh: 在這個句式中，consider 後面通常不使用 as。

examples.en: The students considered the failed experiment a blessing in disguise.
examples.zh: 學生認為實驗失敗反而是因禍得福。

examples.en: Years later, he called the rejection a blessing in disguise.
examples.zh: 多年後，他稱這次拒絕為因禍得福。

specificForms.titleEn: What Seemed Like X + Be + a Blessing in Disguise
specificForms.titleZh: 看似一場災難的事情，其實是因禍得福
specificForms.formula: What seemed like X + be + a blessing in disguise
specificForms.descriptionEn: This pattern directly contrasts the first appearance with the later reality.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 看似一場災難的事情，其實是因禍得福。 這個句式直接對比事情最初的表象與後來的真實結果。

examples.en: What seemed like a disaster was a blessing in disguise.
examples.zh: 看似一場災難的事情，其實是因禍得福。

examples.en: What looked like bad luck turned out to be a blessing in disguise.
examples.zh: 看似倒霉的事情，結果反而是好事。

specificForms.titleEn: It + Be + a Blessing in Disguise + That-Clause
specificForms.formula: It + was / may be + a blessing in disguise + that + clause.
specificForms.descriptionEn: The that-clause identifies the event being evaluated.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 子句指出被評價的事情。

examples.en: It was a blessing in disguise that the problem appeared before the busy season.
examples.zh: 問題在繁忙季節前出現，反而是因禍得福。

examples.en: It may be a blessing in disguise that the decision has been delayed.
examples.zh: 決定被延遲，可能反而是好事。

specificForms.titleEn: The Target inside a Relative Clause or Appositive
specificForms.titleZh: 在關係子句或同位語中使用目標表達
specificForms.descriptionEn: These patterns place the expression in the middle of the sentence rather than always at the end.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 這些句式把目標慣用語放在句子中間，避免所有答案都把它放在相同位置。

examples.en: The delay, which proved to be a blessing in disguise, gave us more time.
examples.zh: 這次延誤結果反而帶來好處，讓我們有更多時間。

examples.en: The storm damage—a blessing in disguise—brought the neighbours together.
examples.zh: 暴風雨造成的損壞反而因禍得福，令鄰居走在一起。

specificForms.titleZh: 先加入回顧或評價短語
specificForms.formula: Looking back, + clause containing the target.
specificForms.descriptionEn: These openings show that the speaker’s understanding changed over time.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 這些開首語表示說話者對事情的理解隨時間改變。

examples.en: Looking back, the change was a blessing in disguise.
examples.zh: 回想起來，這項改變原來是因禍得福。

examples.en: Only later did we realise that the delay had been a blessing in disguise.
examples.zh: 我們到了後來才明白，這次延誤原來是因禍得福。

examples.en: As it turned out, the cancelled flight was a blessing in disguise.
examples.zh: 結果，航班取消反而是因禍得福。

benefits.titleEn: It Creates a Clear Before-and-After Contrast
benefits.titleZh: 清楚對比最初印象與後來結果
benefits.en: The expression shows that the speaker’s first judgement was incomplete.
benefits.zh: 這個表達說明說話者最初的判斷並不完整。

benefits.en: It was a blessing in disguise.
benefits.zh: 這個慣用語可以把「事情起初看似不幸，但後來意外帶來好結果」濃縮成一個簡潔表達。

benefits.titleEn: It Helps Speakers Reflect on Past Events
benefits.en: The sentence shows that the speaker’s present understanding is different from the original reaction.
benefits.zh: 回想起來，失去那份工作原來是因禍得福。 這句話表示說話者現在的理解與當時的反應不同。

examples.en: Looking back, losing that job was a blessing in disguise.
examples.zh: 回想起來，失去那份工作原來是因禍得福。

benefits.en: The speaker does not promise a good result but leaves open that possibility.
benefits.zh: 這次延誤可能反而是好事。 說話者並沒有保證一定會有好結果，只是保留這種可能性。

examples.en: This delay might be a blessing in disguise.
examples.zh: 這次延誤可能反而是好事。

benefits.titleEn: It Gives a Natural Way to Explain Unexpected Benefits
benefits.titleZh: 自然說明意想不到的好處
benefits.en: a safer decision; a useful lesson; a stronger relationship; a better plan.
benefits.zh: 當一次不便帶來更好的機會、更多準備時間、重要發現、更安全的決定、實用教訓、更穩固的關係或更好的計劃時，這個表達十分有用。

benefits.titleEn: It Supports Different Grammar and Sentence Positions
benefits.en: after be; after turn out to be; after prove to be; after a modal verb; after see or regard...as; after consider or call; inside a what-clause structure; inside a relative clause; near the beginning, middle or end of a sentence.
benefits.zh: 因此，學生可以在不同句式及篇章位置自然運用這個慣用語，而不必把所有答案寫成完全相同的結構。

origin.statusEn: Early Printed Use Documented; Exact First Use Uncertain
origin.statusZh: 早期文字記錄可確認；確切首次用法不明

history.en: A commonly cited early printed appearance is connected with the English writer and clergyman James Hervey. His Reflections on a Flower-Garden was published in 1746, and phrase-history research identifies Hervey’s work as containing an early occurrence of the expression. However, the exact first spoken use remains uncertain, so the 1746 record should not automatically be described as the moment the idiom was invented.
history.zh: 一個經常被引用的早期文字記錄與英國作家及牧師 James Hervey 有關。 他的 Reflections on a Flower-Garden 於1746年出版，而短語歷史研究指出，Hervey 的作品包含這個表達的早期用例。 不過，它在口語中首次出現的確切時間仍不清楚，因此不應直接把1746年的記錄說成這個慣用語被創造的一刻。

history.en: The combination therefore describes a benefit hidden inside something that initially looks harmful or unfortunate.
history.zh: 這個表達結合兩個概念：

origin.memoryEn: The bad event is the disguise; the later benefit is the blessing hidden underneath.
origin.memoryZh: 壞事只是外表上的偽裝；後來出現的好處，才是隱藏其中的 blessing。

rules.titleEn: There Must Be an Initial Negative Appearance
rules.titleZh: 規則一：事情起初必須看似負面
rules.en: bad; unlucky; disappointing; inconvenient; difficult; worrying.
rules.zh: 事情起初應該看似不幸、倒霉、令人失望、不方便、困難或令人擔心。 第一場比賽落敗原來是因禍得福，因為它讓我們知道需要改善甚麼。 贏得第一場比賽本來已是明顯的好事，並沒有「壞事背後隱藏好處」的對比。

examples.en: Losing the first match was a blessing in disguise because it showed us what we needed to improve.
examples.zh: 第一場比賽落敗原來是因禍得福，因為它讓我們知道需要改善甚麼。

examples.en: Winning the first match was a blessing in disguise because everyone was happy.
examples.zh: 贏得第一場比賽本來已是明顯的好事，並沒有「壞事背後隱藏好處」的對比。

rules.titleEn: A Real Later Benefit Must Exist
rules.titleZh: 規則二：後來必須出現真正好處
rules.en: The idiom cannot be used merely because a bad event has ended. Nothing explains what good result followed.
rules.zh: 不能只因一件壞事已經結束，便使用這個慣用語。 句子沒有說明其後出現了甚麼好結果。 會議被取消，讓我們有時間修改報告。 這原來是因禍得福。

examples.en: The meeting was cancelled, which gave us time to correct the report. It was a blessing in disguise.
examples.zh: 會議被取消，讓我們有時間修改報告。這原來是因禍得福。

rules.en: Do not change may or could into a definite was unless the source confirms the positive result.
rules.zh: 如果原句只表示可能性，便不可把 may 或 could 改成表示確定事實的 was。

rules.en: The noun blessing is singular and countable in this expression.
rules.zh: 在這個表達中，blessing 是單數可數名詞，因此需要冠詞 a。

rules.titleZh: 規則五：in disguise 必須保持完整
rules.zh: 介詞 in 是固定部分。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Confuse “Turn Out” and “End Up”
rules.titleZh: 規則六：不要混淆 turn out 與 end up
rules.en: Do Not Confuse “Turn Out” and “End Up”
rules.zh: 不要混淆 turn out 與 end up

rules.titleZh: 規則七：只在適當動詞後使用 as
rules.zh: 只在適當動詞後使用 as

rules.titleEn: Do Not Use It Too Early
rules.en: Avoid presenting an uncertain benefit as a fact.
rules.zh: 當好結果尚未出現時，應使用審慎語氣，不要把未確定的好處說成事實。

rules.titleZh: 規則九：避免不顧他人感受的用法
rules.en: It may sound insensitive to describe another person’s serious illness, loss or painful experience as a blessing in disguise, especially while the person is still suffering.
rules.zh: 如果別人正在經歷嚴重疾病、損失或痛苦，便把對方的經歷稱為 a blessing in disguise，可能會顯得冷漠。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Confuse It with a Generally Positive Event
rules.titleZh: 規則十：不要用於本來已是好事的事情
rules.en: A promotion is normally good news. It is not automatically a blessing in disguise.
rules.zh: 升職本來通常已是好消息，因此不一定符合這個慣用語的意思。 第一次未獲升職反而是因禍得福，因為這令她在別處找到更好的職位。

examples.en: Being refused the first promotion was a blessing in disguise because it led her to a better position elsewhere.
examples.zh: 第一次未獲升職反而是因禍得福，因為這令她在別處找到更好的職位。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Repeat the General Meaning Unnecessarily
rules.titleZh: 規則十一：不要不必要地重複一般意思
rules.en: The explanation merely repeats the definition. The extension identifies the specific benefit.
rules.zh: 解釋部分只是重複慣用語本身的意思。 延伸部分指出具體好處。

rules.titleEn: Related Expressions Are Not the Target
rules.titleZh: 規則十二：相關表達並非本課目標
rules.en: Related Expressions Are Not the Target
rules.zh: 相關表達並非本課目標

instructions.en: Rewrite or respond to each item using a blessing in disguise.
instructions.zh: 使用 a blessing in disguise 改寫句子或完成回應。

questions.prompt: Daniel failed his first driving test. The extra practice later made him a much safer driver.
questions.promptZh: 丹尼爾第一次駕駛考試不合格。其後額外的練習令他成為一名安全得多的司機。
questions.answer: Failing his first driving test was a blessing in disguise because it made Daniel practise more and become a safer driver.
questions.answerZh: 第一次駕駛考試不合格反而令丹尼爾因禍得福，因為這促使他多加練習，成為更安全的司機。
questions.targetMeaning: A blessing in disguise is something that seems bad, unlucky or disappointing at first but later produces a good result or unexpected advantage.

questions.prompt: Heavy rain forced the school to delay sports day. By the new date, an injured pupil had recovered and could take part.
questions.promptZh: 大雨迫使學校延遲舉行陸運會。到了新日期，一名受傷的學生已經康復，可以參加。
questions.answer: The rain that delayed sports day was a blessing in disguise because it gave the injured pupil time to recover.
questions.answerZh: 令陸運會延期的大雨原來是因禍得福，因為它讓受傷的學生有時間康復。
questions.targetMeaning: A blessing in disguise is something that seems bad, unlucky or disappointing at first but later produces a good result or unexpected advantage.

questions.prompt: We took the wrong road and felt annoyed. However, it led us to a quicker route that we now use every week.
questions.promptZh: 我們走錯了路，當時感到很煩惱。不過，這令我們發現一條更快捷的路線，現在每星期也會使用。
questions.answer: Taking the wrong road turned out to be a blessing in disguise because it helped us find a quicker route.
questions.answerZh: 走錯路結果反而是因禍得福，因為這令我們找到一條更快捷的路線。
questions.targetMeaning: A blessing in disguise is something that seems bad, unlucky or disappointing at first but later produces a good result or unexpected advantage.

questions.prompt: The shop had sold out of the jacket Ava wanted. She later found the same jacket at another shop for a much lower price.
questions.promptZh: 艾娃想買的外套在店內已經售罄。後來，她在另一間店以便宜得多的價格買到同一款外套。
questions.answer: Although the sold-out jacket seemed disappointing at first, it was a blessing in disguise because Ava found it much cheaper elsewhere.
questions.answerZh: 雖然外套售罄起初令人失望，但這原來是因禍得福，因為艾娃在別處以便宜得多的價格買到它。
questions.targetMeaning: A blessing in disguise is something that seems bad, unlucky or disappointing at first but later produces a good result or unexpected advantage.

questions.prompt: Leo was upset about his low test mark. It showed him exactly which topic he needed to study, and his next mark was much higher.
questions.promptZh: 里奧因測驗分數低而感到不快。這讓他清楚知道需要溫習哪個課題，而他下一次的分數高了很多。
questions.answer: At first, Leo’s low mark felt like bad news, but it was a blessing in disguise because it showed him what to study.
questions.answerZh: 起初，里奧的低分看似是壞消息，但它其實帶來了好處，因為這讓他知道應該溫習甚麼。
questions.targetMeaning: A blessing in disguise is something that seems bad, unlucky or disappointing at first but later produces a good result or unexpected advantage.

questions.prompt: Chloe’s phone broke, so she spent a week without social media. During that week, she slept better and felt less worried.
questions.promptZh: 克洛伊的電話壞了，因此她有一星期沒有使用社交媒體。那一星期，她睡得更好，也沒有那麼憂慮。
questions.answer: Being without her phone for a week turned out to be a blessing in disguise because Chloe slept better and felt less worried.
questions.answerZh: 一星期沒有電話使用，結果反而令克洛伊因禍得福，因為她睡得更好，也沒有那麼憂慮。
questions.targetMeaning: A blessing in disguise is something that seems bad, unlucky or disappointing at first but later produces a good result or unexpected advantage.

questions.prompt: We missed the early train. While waiting for the next one, we realised that we had left our passports at home.
questions.promptZh: 我們錯過了早班火車。等待下一班車時，我們發現把護照留在家中。
questions.answer: Perhaps missing the early train was a blessing in disguise, since it gave us time to notice that our passports were at home.
questions.answerZh: 也許錯過早班火車反而是因禍得福，因為這給了我們時間發現護照仍在家中。
questions.targetMeaning: A blessing in disguise is something that seems bad, unlucky or disappointing at first but later produces a good result or unexpected advantage.

questions.prompt: Rachel’s application for the first flat was refused. A week later, she found a larger flat with lower rent.
questions.promptZh: 瑞秋申請第一個單位時被拒絕。一星期後，她找到一個更大而租金更低的單位。
questions.answer: The rejection of Rachel’s first flat application proved to be a blessing in disguise because she later found a larger and cheaper home.

questions.prompt: Our flight home was cancelled, so we had to stay one more day. That extra day allowed us to meet a local guide who showed us the best part of the trip.
questions.promptZh: 我們回程的航班被取消，因此必須多留一天。額外的一天讓我們遇到一名本地導遊，而他帶我們遊覽了整個旅程中最精彩的地方。
questions.answer: As it turned out, the cancelled flight was a blessing in disguise because the extra day became the best part of our trip.
questions.answerZh: 結果，航班取消反而是因禍得福，因為額外的一天成為我們旅程中最精彩的部分。
questions.targetMeaning: A blessing in disguise is something that seems bad, unlucky or disappointing at first but later produces a good result or unexpected advantage.

questions.prompt: The family dog ran away and was found at a nearby animal clinic. During a check, the vet discovered an illness early enough to treat it easily.
questions.promptZh: 家中的狗走失了，後來在附近的動物診所被找到。檢查期間，獸醫及早發現了一種疾病，因此可以輕易治療。
questions.answer: The dog’s escape, frightening as it was, became a blessing in disguise because the animal clinic found its illness in time.
questions.answerZh: 狗隻走失雖然令人害怕，但最後反而是因禍得福，因為動物診所及時發現了牠的疾病。
questions.targetMeaning: A blessing in disguise is something that seems bad, unlucky or disappointing at first but later produces a good result or unexpected advantage.

questions.prompt: Ben was refused a place on the university course he had chosen. During a year of work, he discovered a different career that he enjoyed far more.
questions.promptZh: 本被心儀的大學課程拒絕取錄。工作一年期間，他發現了另一項自己更加喜歡的事業。
questions.answer: Years later, Ben could honestly call the university rejection a blessing in disguise because it led him to a career he enjoyed more.
questions.answerZh: 多年後，本可以真誠地把大學拒絕取錄稱為因禍得福，因為這令他找到一項更喜歡的事業。
questions.targetMeaning: A blessing in disguise is something that seems bad, unlucky or disappointing at first but later produces a good result or unexpected advantage.

questions.prompt: The company lost one large client, which was worrying at first. The free time allowed it to improve its service and attract several smaller clients.
questions.promptZh: 公司失去了一名大客戶，起初令人擔心。空出的時間讓公司改善服務，並吸引數名較小的客戶。
questions.answer: The loss of the large client was not welcome, yet it ultimately proved to be a blessing in disguise because the company attracted several smaller clients and no longer depended on only one.
questions.answerZh: 失去大客戶並不是一件令人高興的事，但最終卻因禍得福，因為公司吸引了數名較小的客戶，不再只依賴一名客戶。
questions.targetMeaning: A blessing in disguise is something that seems bad, unlucky or disappointing at first but later produces a good result or unexpected advantage.

questions.prompt: The main actor in the school play became ill on opening night. The pupil who took the actor’s place performed extremely well and gained new confidence.
questions.promptZh: 學校話劇的主角在首演當晚生病。代替主角的學生表現非常出色，並建立了新的自信。
questions.answer: What looked like a crisis on opening night was a blessing in disguise because it gave the other pupil a chance to perform and gain confidence.
questions.answerZh: 首演當晚看似一場危機的事情，原來是因禍得福，因為這讓另一名學生有機會表演並建立自信。
questions.targetMeaning: A blessing in disguise is something that seems bad, unlucky or disappointing at first but later produces a good result or unexpected advantage.

questions.prompt: The seller chose another buyer, so the family could not purchase the house. After heavy rain, they learnt that the house had a serious flooding problem.
questions.promptZh: 賣方選擇了另一名買家，因此這個家庭無法購買該房屋。大雨過後，他們得知該房屋有嚴重的水浸問題。
questions.answer: Only after the heavy rain did the family understand that losing the house had been a blessing in disguise because it had a serious flooding problem.
questions.answerZh: 這個家庭到了大雨過後才明白，未能買到該房屋原來是因禍得福，因為房屋有嚴重的水浸問題。

questions.answer: Looking back, the forced pause was a blessing in disguise because it led the team to a safer and cheaper design.
